source: Källa: SCB, Statistikdatabasen (CC BY 4.0): folkmängd och flyttningar per ålder; SKR, Kommungruppsindelning 2023
unit: net migration (domestic and foreign) per inhabitant of the age group at the start of the year; age at the end of the year
note: Group rates are pooled: the sum of the flows over the sum of the population in the group's municipalities, with the 2023 classification for all years. 2025 is perturbed by SCB (Cell Key Method).
